The role requires strong frontend and backend development capabilities along with practical knowledge of integrating Large Language Models, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and AI APIs into production applications. Develop scalable and high-performance backend applications using Python with FastAPI, Django, and Flask . Build robust RESTful APIs , backend services, and microservices for SaaS and enterprise applications. Design secure, modular, reusable, and maintainable backend architectures. Develop APIs using FastAPI with asynchronous programming, dependency injection, request validation, and automatic API documentation. Develop web applications and backend systems using Django , including Django REST Framework (DRF), ORM, middleware, authentication, and admin functionality. Develop lightweight and modular backend services using Flask and its extensions where required. Implement authentication, authorization, JWT/OAuth, role-based access control, input validation, logging, and error handling . Design and develop database models, schemas, relationships, migrations, and optimized database queries. Integrate third-party APIs, external services, payment gateways, cloud services, and enterprise systems . Develop business logic, reusable backend modules, services, utilities, and APIs for scalable SaaS applications. Optimize API performance, database queries, memory usage, and response times . Implement asynchronous programming, background tasks, job queues, scheduled jobs, and event-driven architecture where required. Work with Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka , or similar background-processing and messaging technologies. Implement proper API versioning, pagination, filtering, caching, rate limiting, and request/response handling . Write clean, modular, reusable, and well-documented Python code following PEP 8 and industry best practices . Develop and maintain unit tests, integration tests, API tests, and automated testing frameworks . Implement secure coding practices to protect backend applications against common vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication issues, and unauthorized access . Work with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud platforms, monitoring, and deployment environments . Troubleshoot production issues, analyze logs, identify root causes, and implement reliable backend solutions. Collaborate with Frontend, AI/ML, DevOps, QA, Product, and other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end applications. 2. Backend Development Develop scalable backend applications using Node.js . Build RESTful APIs and backend services. Design secure and reusable API architectures. Implement authentication, authorization, validation, logging, and error handling. Integrate third-party APIs and external services. Develop business logic and backend modules for SaaS and enterprise applications. Optimize backend performance and API response times. Work with asynchronous programming, background jobs, queues, and event-driven architecture where required. Candidates with strong backend development experience in Node.js OR Python (FastAPI/Django/Flask) can be considered for the position. 3. AI / LLM Integration Integrate LLM and Generative AI capabilities into web applications. Work with APIs from OpenAI and other LLM providers. Develop AI-powered features such as: AI assistants Chatbots Intelligent search Content generation Document analysis Summarization Question answering AI recommendations Classification and extraction Develop effective prompts and structured AI workflows. Handle LLM responses, streaming, context management, token limitations, and error handling. Integrate AI functionality into frontend and backend applications. 4. RAG Development Develop and integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications. Work with document ingestion and processing pipelines. Implement: Document parsing Text chunking Embeddings Semantic search Retrieval Context generation LLM response generation Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS , or equivalent technologies. Improve retrieval quality, relevance, latency, and response accuracy. Implement metadata filtering and hybrid search where required. Build knowledge-base and enterprise document intelligence solutions. 5. Database Development Work with MongoDB and/or MySQL/PostgreSQL . Design database schemas and data models. Develop efficient queries and indexes. Implement CRUD operations and transaction handling. Optimize database performance. Work with data relationships, aggregation, pagination, and search. Ensure data integrity and secure database access. 6. API & System Integration Develop and consume REST APIs. Integrate third-party services, payment APIs, authentication services, cloud services, and AI APIs. Work with JSON, HTTP, WebSockets, and asynchronous APIs. Implement API validation, security, rate limiting, logging, and monitoring. Coordinate with frontend, backend, AI/ML, QA, and DevOps teams for end-to-end integration. 7. Security & Performance Follow secure coding practices. Protect APIs and applications against common web vulnerabilities. Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms. Secure API keys, tokens, credentials, and sensitive information. Optimize frontend rendering, API performance, database queries, and AI response latency. Participate in code reviews and technical quality checks. 8. Testing & Debugging Write clean and testable code. Perform unit, integration, and functional testing. Debug frontend, backend, API, database, and AI integration issues. Work closely with QA teams to resolve defects. Ensure applications meet functional, performance, and security requirements. 9. Deployment & Collaboration Collaborate with DevOps engineers for application deployment and production releases. Understand basic Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and environment configuration. Work with Git and Git-based development workflows. Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings, sprint planning, code reviews, and technical discussions. Prepare technical documentation when required. Node.js Express.js or equivalent Node.js framework REST API Development Authentication & Authorization API Security Asynchronous Programming Backend Python-Candidates with strong backend development experience in Node.js OR Python (FastAPI/Django/Flask) can be considered for the position. Deploy and maintain solutions using Docker and CI/CD pipelines . Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-ready Python code. Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions. Stay current with developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI . Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table Python & Backend Development 4–6 years of professional experience in Python development . Strong understanding of OOP, data structures, exception handling, and concurrency (asyncio/threading) . Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Django REST Framework . Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs . Good understanding of SQL and relational databases ( PostgreSQL/MySQL ); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred. Agentic AI / GenAI Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept. Understanding of agentic AI architecture , including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows. Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen . Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs. Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search . Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent . Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs . Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations. Experience building multi-agent systems . Cloud & DevOps Experience with Docker and containerized applications. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP . Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments. Education & Soft Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field . Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong communication and documentation skills. Good to Have Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n . Experience with document AI : extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents. Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms. Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka . Experience with Kubernetes . Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models. Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization . Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS . What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions , not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services , preferably deployed in production. Apply through the Sirion Careers page and follow the steps listed there. 4-7 Yrs Fullstack Development, Python, Senior, Software, Full Stack, Stack, Development

The role provides leadership for AI engineering organizations and serves as the accountable owner for AI platforms, intelligent automation capabilities, machine learning solutions, and emerging AI technologies that support business transformation. The position focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes through AI while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and governance. The Senior Director is responsible for setting the technical and business direction for AI programs, establishing multi-year roadmaps, prioritizing investments, and aligning technology execution with organizational goals. They work closely with business leaders, product teams, operations partners, architecture groups, and executive leadership to identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, reduce cost, enhance customer experiences, and create new capabilities. Success is measured not only by technology delivery but also by adoption, operational impact, productivity gains, and financial value creation. As a people leader, the role oversees a team of engineering leaders, AI engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, and platform specialists distributed across onshore and offshore locations. Responsibilities include organizational design, talent strategy, workforce planning, hiring, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning. The Senior Director creates an environment of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and engineering excellence while building a solid leadership bench capable of scaling enterprise AI capabilities. From a technology perspective, this leader owns the end-to-end lifecycle of AI solutions, including platform architecture, model deployment, intelligent agents, automation frameworks, cloud infrastructure, production operations, observability, and reliability engineering. The role ensures that AI capabilities are developed as reusable enterprise assets rather than isolated solutions, enabling faster adoption and greater return on investment across multiple business domains. The position carries significant accountability for Responsible AI, compliance, security, and risk management. The Senior Director ensures that all AI solutions comply with governance requirements, regulatory obligations, ethical AI principles, privacy standards, and operational controls. They establish processes for model monitoring, performance measurement, incident management, human oversight, and continuous improvement to maintain trust and reliability at enterprise scale. The role requires solid executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders across the organization. The Senior Director regularly communicates strategy, progress, risks, investment needs, and business outcomes to executives while building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. They act as the bridge between technology and business organizations, ensuring that AI investments are translated into meaningful operational and financial results. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: About us We're a small, fast-growing digital marketing agency, and we're betting big on AI to run a leaner, smarter business. We want to automate the repetitive work across support, sales and customer success so our team can focus on strategy, creativity and clients. You'll be the person who makes that happen. The role We're hiring a full-time AI Automation Expert to design, build and maintain AI-powered systems across the agency. You'll work hands-on with Claude Code and Grok (xAI) to turn manual workflows into reliable automations, connect them to our tools (Go High Level & Monday.com), and keep improving them as we grow. This is a builder role with real ownership. You'll scope problems with team leads, ship working solutions quickly, and document them so the team can use them every day. What you'll build Your first projects will cover three areas of the business, with plenty more to follow. AI support ticketing system: an intake, triage and routing system that categorizes client requests, drafts responses and escalates to the right person. Sales lead sourcing bot: a bot that finds and qualifies prospects that match our ideal client profile, enriches their data and pushes them into our pipeline. Customer success call intelligence: automations that capture client call data (summaries, action items, sentiment, upsell signals) and organize it in Monday.com. Whatever comes next: reporting, campaign workflows, internal tools and any process where AI can save time or improve quality. Responsibilities Audit our workflows across support, sales and customer success, and identify the highest-impact automation opportunities. Design, build, test and deploy AI automations using Claude Code, Grok and related APIs. Integrate AI systems with our tools, especially Monday.com, & Go High Level plus email, call recording, calendar and lead data platforms. Build prompts, agents and workflows that are reliable, monitored and easy to update. Write clear documentation and train team members to use what you build. Track results (time saved, response times, leads generated) and iterate based on feedback. Handle client and company data securely and responsibly. Stay current on new AI tools and recommend the ones worth adopting. Requirements Proven hands-on experience building with Claude Code and the Grok (xAI) API. Please show us real projects. 2+ years building automations, integrations or software, ideally for business operations. Strong skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience integrating with CRMs or work management platforms. Monday.com & GHL experience is a big plus. Solid prompt engineering and experience building AI agents or multi-step workflows. Able to take a loosely defined business problem and turn it into a working, documented solution. Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable explaining technical work to non-technical teammates. Available to work 9am-5pm Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. Nice to have Experience at or with a digital marketing agency. Familiarity with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier or n8n. Experience with call recording and transcription tools (e.g., Fathom) or speech-to-text APIs. Lead enrichment and scraping tools (e.g., Apollo, Clay) and an understanding of data privacy rules. Experience with helpdesk platforms or building ticketing systems. Compensation, hours and location Pay: $1,500 - $2,500 USD per month, based on experience Hours: Full-time, 9am-5pm Eastern Time (EST/EDT), MondayFriday Location: Remote Hiring process Our process ends with a paid, real-world project so you can show what you can build, and we can see how you work. Application review: we review your application and portfolio of AI automation work. Intro call (30 min): a conversation about your background, tools and how you approach automation problems. Technical interview ( 30 min): a walkthrough of a past project you built with Claude Code or Grok. Paid final project (top 3 candidates): you'll build a working AI support ticketing system prototype for our agency. You'll be paid for your time, and we'll provide a brief, success criteria and a deadline. Final review and offer: you'll present your project, and we'll choose the best fit for the team. 0-6 Yrs Automation engineering, Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Workflow, Python, Workflow Automation, Integration, Zapier

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer
jobs.description: About Us Exotel is the emerging markets leading full-stack customer engagement platform and business-focused virtual telecom operator. Founded in 2011, our cloud-based product suite powers over 50 million daily engagements across voice, video, and messaging channels. Trusted by 6,000+ companies across 60+ countriesincluding India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa—Exotel enables unified customer engagement for leading businesses such as Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Byju’s, HDFC Bank, Zomato, and Urban Company. Our offerings include communication APIs, a modern omnichannel contact center, and a conversational AI platform hosted on the cloud. We are a Series D company valued at $100 million with $60 million in ARR. Level: L1 @Professional Services The Professional Services team is the "Special Forces" of our engineering organization. We don't just build products; we solve high-stakes enterprise puzzles. Our engineering solves infrastructure-level problems to ensure no one misses a call or an SMS, even in highly customized enterprise environments. We focus on building fault-tolerant, scalable, and real-time distributed systems that integrate seamlessly with complex enterprise ecosystems. Our stack is diverse—built on PHP, Python, Golang, and Node.js—and we emphasize clean abstractions and loosely coupled services. We leverage MySQL, NoSQL stores, Elasticsearch for discovery, and Grafana/Kibana for deep observability. We are firm believers in "You build it, you own it!"—operating a distributed system in a customization-heavy environment requires a true DevOps mindset. Roles & Responsibilities: As a Integration and Customization Engineer - 1, in the Professional Services team, you will be the technical anchor for complex ECC (Enterprise Contact Center) project customizations. Your role is a blend of deep engineering, architectural solutioning, and high-impact delivery. Engineering Excellence: Design and develop high-complexity customizations, integrations, and automation modules for large-scale enterprise customers. Technical Leadership: Independently deliver complex modules and take ownership of the end-to-end execution of internal projects. Mentorship: Guide and unblock L1 engineers, ensuring the team maintains high coding standards and best practices. System Ownership: Navigate and optimize forked, legacy, or complex codebases to ensure high performance and reliability. Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Infosec, and Customer-facing teams to translate enterprise requirements into executable technical roadmaps. Quality Assurance: Ensure uncompromising quality through rigorous code reviews, comprehensive test plans, and flawless deployment execution. Operational Health: Track and report engineering health metrics, ensuring that production incidents are minimized and resolution is swift. Must-haves 1–2 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science. Advanced proficiency in PHP and expert knowledge of HTML, CSS, and React.JS Deep mastery of Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), Concurrency, and Multithreading. Practical experience with 3-Tier and Microservices architectures, RESTful services, and HTTP protocols. Expert in SQL/NoSQL data modeling, caching layers, and building/deploying Linux-based applications. Understanding of TCP/IP networks and Linux OS configuration. A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex delivery cycles and production quality. Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while handling the maturity required for enterprise stakeholder interaction. General Skills Ability to translate deep technical hurdles into clear, actionable roadmaps for Product, Infosec, and enterprise clients. Mastery of the SDLC and project management tools like Jira/Confluence to ensure transparency and timeline alignment. Strong capability in creating technical diagrams, flowcharts, and project scope documents to maintain system clarity. Leadership: Proactive in unblocking peers and collaborating across cross-functional units (Development, Vendors, Partners). Good-to-haves Experience with GenAI technologies and their practical applications in enterprise workflows. Familiarity with visualization tools like Grafana and Kibana. Experience with cloud deployments (AWS/GCP/Azure) and a strong affinity for DevOps culture. Experience working in customization-heavy environments or managing "forked" codebases. What differentiates a successful candidate? The Average Candidate: Can write code to a specification but struggles when the documentation is missing, or the codebase is "messy." The A-Player: Sees a complex legacy codebase as a challenge to be mastered. They don't just fix bugs; they refactor for scale, mentor those around them, and anticipate enterprise needs before they become bottlenecks. They possess the technical depth to code and the maturity to navigate a high-pressure production environment. What success looks like (first 90 days) In this role, success is measured by your ability to move from code fluency to system-ownership. We expect high-impact contributions in two key areas: End-to-End Ownership of Complexity: Within 90 days, you will have taken full responsibility for the design, implementation, and production stabilization of a high-complexity enterprise customization. You aren't just writing code; you are operating with a "you build it, you own it" mindset, ensuring that your modules are fault-tolerant, scalable, and meet all engineering health metrics. Technical Leadership & Unblocking: You will be a recognized technical anchor who independently identifies and resolves architectural challenges within legacy or forked codebases. Success means you are effectively guiding L1 engineers through rigorous code reviews and test plans, while confidently managing technical trade-offs in discussions with enterprise stakeholders. 1-5 Yrs Python, Node.js, Full Stack, Java, PHP, Development, Fullstack Development, React.js

jobs.description: Join us at Orange Business! With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities. Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and design patterns. Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git. You enjoy solving complex problems, improving code quality and system performance, and collaborating with product, QA, and engineering teams. In senior roles, you also focus on mentoring teammates, sharing knowledge, and helping teams deliver work effectively. You are interested in this position because it would let you contribute hands-on while helping shape scalable solutions and supporting the growth of the team. You bring open mindedness, ability to handle pressure, leading with courage and empathy, assertiveness and communicate effectively. jobs.description: ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient. Our employees passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion - and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations - we invite you to join us! ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Global Support Engineer - DERMSSolutions Location: New Delhi, India We are building ETAPs Global Support Group - a globally distributed, domain-specialized support organization designed to be the technical backbone behind ETAPs real-time control and automation systems deployed worldwide. This is not a project execution role. It is something different, and for the right person, more interesting. As a Global Support Engineer for DERMS Global Solutions, you will be ETAPs first line of technical support for intelligent load shedding and generation control systems across global clients - utilities, industrial facilities, generation plants, and critical infrastructure operators in the US, Latin America, the Middle East, Europe, India, Asia Pacific and Australia. Where project execution means delivering one system at a time, this role means your work supports every customer running these solutions, everywhere. Your core domain is ETAPs real-time automation and control suite: Intelligent Load Shedding (ILS) and Automatic Generation Control (AGC). These are your specialty, and you will own them with depth. You will also provide broader support across the DERMS solution portfolio, including microgrid and power plant control systems where global support coverage is needed. You will work through a structured ticket system, coordinating with global technical leads and regional teams, anchoring DERMS support out of India. If you have built your technical depth delivering these systems in the field and want to take it global, this is that role. Responsibilities - You will do: Own and resolve Level 1 support tickets for ETAP real-time automation and control solutions globally - with Intelligent Load Shedding (ILS) and Automatic Generation Control (AGC) as your core domain - through Jira, with a target 24-hour response and resolution discipline on standard incidents. Perform systematic first-line diagnosis: reproduce the reported issue, isolate the root cause, determine whether it is configuration, integration, or product-level, and resolve or route accordingly before any escalation. Troubleshoot ILS schemes including load preservation, load restoration, and load shedding validation logic, as well as AGC functions including load frequency control, area control error, and generator power sharing behavior. Provide broader DERMS portfolio support, including microgrid (uGrid) and power plant control fundamentals, to maintain global support coverage across the solution family. Communicate resolution, root cause, and next steps clearly and professionally to global clients and regional teams - in English, in writing, without ambiguity. Maintain and expand the Global Support knowledge base by documenting recurring issues, confirmed root causes, resolutions, and workarounds for reuse across the team. Provide complete pre-diagnosis before escalating to Level 2 - cases that reach the next level must arrive with a clear incident summary, reproduction steps, findings, and your assessment of what the issue is and is not. Coordinate with Global Support leadership on ticket queue priorities, status visibility, and escalation decisions. Requirements - You need to have: Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher) - this is a global role and the vast majority of support interactions are in English with clients across the US, Middle East, Latin America, Europe, India, Asia Pacific and Australia. Written English quality directly reflects on ETAPs support standard. Demonstrated hands-on competency delivering or supporting ETAP Intelligent Load Shedding (ILS) and Automatic Generation Control (AGC) projects - you must be able to troubleshoot these systems independently from day one without relying on escalation for standard incidents. Working familiarity with the underlying real-time platform - eSCADA and PSMS - sufficient to understand how ILS and AGC solutions are built on top of them and to navigate the monitoring and control environment confidently. Deep SME-level mastery of eSCADA and PSMS is not required. Prior ETAP project execution or technical support experience in a client-facing context - you understand how these systems are deployed, configured, commissioned, and operated in the field. Systematic and methodical troubleshooting mindset - you can reproduce a reported issue, isolate the failure point, document your findings clearly, and communicate them without being guided step by step. Strong written communication skills - every ticket update, client response, and escalation summary must be accurate, professional, and complete. Ability to manage multiple concurrent support cases across different clients, priorities, and time zones without losing ownership or follow-through on any of them. A Plus to have: Exposure to ETAP uGrid (Microgrid Controller) or Power Plant Controller (PPC) - conceptual or practical understanding of grid-tied and islanded operation, DER integration, and how microgrid and plant control interact with load shedding and generation control functions. Hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols - DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850 - at a troubleshooting level, not just conceptual. Experience using Jira or comparable ticketing platforms for support workflow management. Background in utility, generation, or industrial environments where real-time power management and control systems are actively deployed and operated. ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. You will also ensure the new architecture continues to support the important use cases handled by our existing legacy monolith and microservices. Our AI agents will use patient context, preferences, workflow state, and tools to: Determine the next best action. Personalize patient communication. Select the right communication channel. Manage the interaction through to completion. This is a mix of greenfield and brownfield development. You will build new services while also replacing or wrapping existing systems that support live patient messaging in production today. Responsibilities Essential Job Responsibilities Lead the technical design and development of the Messaging 3.0 AI platform. Build production-grade AI agents using LLM orchestration, tools, context, evaluation, guardrails, and observability. jobs.description: Opkey invites you to join its fast-growing Accelerator Team in Noida, as an : Trainee Automation Test Engineer. About Opkey: Opkey is the leading Cloud Application Lifecycle Management (CALM) platform for Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, Coupa, and more. It cuts the costs and risks that drag down implementations and ongoing change, helping you go live on time, get more from your cloud app investments, and reach AI readiness faster. Opkeys 20+ AI agents manage all five phases of the cloud application lifecycle-Define, Design, Configure, Test and Train. Whether it s a new implementation, a platform update, or business-as-usual change, Opkey handles it all: updates validated in hours, self-healing tests, end-to-end integrations assured, configurations synced, and training updated in real time-all delivered in a single unified platform instead of a patchwork of disconnected tools. Powered by Argus, a domain-specific AI model trained on decades of expertise and terabytes of enterprise application data, Opkey automates configuration, testing, change impact analysis, and training across these applications-cutting manual effort by 80%, enabling 30% faster go-lives, and slashing downtime risk by 92% Roles and Responsibilities: - Identifying and selecting the automation test cases - Applying various designs and documenting the automation test strategy - Creating an automation test plan and getting approval - Configuring Selenium Test Environment (STE) in order to set it up - Participating in Selenium Environment Setup with an Integrated Development Environment (IDE) - Automating the design of a framework - Implementing it as per the structure of the project - Creating, enhancing, debugging, and running the test cases - Collating and monitoring the defect management process - Managing the changes and executing regression tests - Coming up with exact solutions for problems related to object identity and error handling - Interacting with customers/clients to solve the various issues they face and updating on the situation Desired Candidate Profile: - 0- 6 months automation testing experience or - Completed training in automation testing and/or good in Java coding. - Effective communication skills.
